question: Does rank-by-full-LC-RMSE + localized densification close into a blind Band-A inversion on seed 116, and is truth the unique best-fitting solution?
hypothesis: One blind round of localized densification + full-LC RMSE rank + hi-fi gate closes a Band-A inversion on seed 116.
narrative_md: One round of localized densification (re-sample isophote inside the surviving cloud, steered by full-LC RMSE rank) pulls a candidate to qa 0.91/qb 1.22°, ω-dir 0.45°. The pipeline closes a blind Band-A inversion (top candidate hi-fi ρ 0.34). Twist: truth is NOT unique/best — full-LC RMSE is non-monotonic; a 15.5° q-offset basin and body-twins fit better (ρ 0.34-0.51) than the ~1° truth perturbation (ρ 1.09); all genuine hi-fi multi-solutions. |ω| band reuses truth as the s092 stand-in → not strictly blind. Densify cross overran 22× (112 min vs ~5 min).
